summary_1line: The text praises charity of food and teaches that universal compassion and treating others as oneself form the core of righteousness.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Rantideva joyfully distributes food to many Brahmanas, symbolizing life-giving charity.
A compassionate sage stands calmly among animals and people, lowering his rod of punishment as he sees all beings as himself.
The divine teacher Vrihaspati finishes instructing Yudhishthira and rises upward toward heaven before the assembled sages.
